facts.fact: The Essaha Aziza programme's results page states that its digitalisation mission for first-line care structures developed the national computerised medical record (DMI) and monitored its deployment on pilot sites in Nabeul; no number of sites is given and the page is undated, so the record's retrieval-based published date of 3 September 2026 is used.

The national DMI for first-line care was developed under the Essaha Aziza programme, which the record's publisher line gives as a Ministry of Health and European Union programme, with training of field teams and developers delivered by the company Elligy; the page body states no amount and no domestic budget line, and is undated (published date of 3 September 2026 used).

systems.system: SISSPL (Système d'Information des Services de Soins de Première Ligne)
systems.platform: bespoke; documentation covers architecture, security policy, continuity plan, professionals directory and a decision-support (reporting) system
systems.owner: Essaha Aziza programme (Ministry of Health / European Union); training by Elligy
systems.tiers: first-line care structures (SSPL); pilot sites in Nabeul

note: The EU's part rests on the record's publisher line and note, not on the page body, which names only the programme. The page has no date of its own.
